{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check if there are any sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline for severe patients
sentinel_count = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0].shape[0]
print(f"Number of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline for severe patients: {sentinel_count}")

# Calculate mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients, excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
